protocol.name: v7-normalization-local-gain-v1
protocol.float32: runtime normalize/aggregate uses float32; numerical errors recorded
protocol.bound: row absolute derivative sum for independently bounded upstream perturbations
protocol.scope: not the closed-loop Jacobian, spectral radius, or proof of instability
protocol.kinks: zero slope at kinks; crossing targets excluded only in derivative checks
protocol.state_protocol: gray 0.5; zero initial state; checkpoints 128 and 2048 microsteps

128.interface_scope: upstream checkpoint to T4 target drive; not a full timestep

limitations: Large local gain alone cannot establish a causal source of feedback instability.
Finite differences use one fixed random direction, not every possible perturbation.
Calibration ranges were fitted without direction labels but are proxy state units.
No normalizer, model parameter, topology, visual gate or deployed policy changed.
